Title: Hoisin Beef & Coleslaw Stir-Fry Bowls (Saltnpiipa)

Items: 4 spring onions, chopped and separated (whites for cooking, greens for garnish)
Spring onion greens (from above), for garnish

Instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red onion, minced garlic, and the whites of the spring onions. Fry for 2–3 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Add the ground beef/pork mix. Season with salt and black pepper. Cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through.
Drain off excess fat from the pan.
Stir in the ground ginger, regular soy sauce, dark soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, chilli flakes, and sesame oil until everything is well coated.
Add the coleslaw mix and stir-fry for 1–2 minutes to start softening it.
Pour in the beef broth and stir. Cook for another 1–3 minutes until the coleslaw is tender-crisp and the sauce lightly coats everything.
Serve over cooked jasmine rice and garnish with the spring onion greens (and coriander/cilantro if using).
Customizations: Add extra veg: sliced peppers, mushrooms, or shredded carrots.
Make it spicy: increase chilli flakes or add a spoon of chilli crisp.
Add crunch: top with toasted sesame seeds or crushed peanuts/cashews.
OptionalInstructions: If the pan looks dry after draining, add a small splash of broth before adding the sauces.
Taste before serving—adjust soy sauce for saltiness and sugar for sweetness.
ServingSuggestions: Garnish with spring onion greens and optional coriander/cilantro.
